describe: make the player bigger or smaller

params.question: Does the message want the player to end up bigger or smaller?

guide: Find the constant the player's rectangle is built from -- usually PLAYER_SIZE -- and change only that number.
report: I $direction $name from $old to $new, so the player is drawn that many pixels across.
$name is $new now, from $old. Everything that uses the player's size follows it.
The player is $new pixels across now -- $name was $old.
teach: The player is a rectangle made from $name, so changing that one number changes its size everywhere it is used.
